description: This file defines the 'Reward' class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class extends the system's Model class and provides methods related to calculating and managing reward points, including obtaining totals, confirming reward redemption, and unconfirming rewards. It interacts with session data, cart products, and customer reward data, and is part of the total extension namespace for modules that affect order totals.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: A class managing reward point calculations including total reward deduction, confirmation, and unconfirmation processes within the OpenCart extension namespace.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total reward points and applies discounts to the order, modifying the totals, taxes, and overall total based on reward points available and customer reward points.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms reward points for an order, awarding the customer reward points based on the order, if they have sufficient reward points.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes the reward points associated with an order, reversing the reward point allocation for that order.
